Discover if We Provide Free Estimates for Your Tree Removal Needs Today!

Everything Northeast Ohio homeowners need to know about our no-obligation estimate process — what’s included, what affects your quote, and how to request yours today.

Roubic Tree & Landscape LLC Updated March 2026  ·  Serving Greater Cleveland, Ohio
Homeowner Guide

If you’ve been wondering whether Roubic Tree & Landscape charges just to come take a look — the answer is no, never. We provide free, no-obligation on-site estimates for all tree removal needs throughout Cuyahoga County and Geauga County, Ohio. A certified arborist visits your property, assesses the job in person, and hands you a clear written quote — with zero pressure and no hidden fees.

We know that calling a tree service can feel like a commitment. Many homeowners worry they’ll feel pressured, receive a vague ballpark number, or discover charges that weren’t discussed once the crew arrives. We built our estimate process specifically to eliminate every one of those concerns. When we arrive at your property, our only goal is to give you the most accurate picture of your situation — so you can make the best decision for your home and budget, on your own timeline.

This guide walks you through exactly what to expect: what’s included in a Roubic estimate, what drives the final quote, why in-person visits matter more than online calculators, and how to request yours today.

What to Expect From Your Free Estimate

01100% free, no-obligation — no charge just to assess your property
02Certified arborist visits your property in person — not over the phone
03Full tree health and structural risk assessment included at no cost
04Written quote covering every cost — no surprises after work starts
05Stump grinding and debris removal options discussed and priced on-site
06Most estimate visits completed in 20–45 minutes
07No follow-up pressure calls — you decide completely on your own timeline
08Covers all services: removal, trimming, stump grinding, land clearing

Every free estimate begins with an arborist walking your property with you — assessing each tree in person before a single dollar is quoted.

Section 01  ·  The Direct Answer

1Yes, We Offer Free Estimates — Here’s What That Actually Means for You

100% Free. Zero Obligation.

Roubic Tree & Landscape provides free, no-obligation on-site estimates for tree removal, tree trimming, stump grinding, and land clearing throughout Cuyahoga and Geauga County, Ohio. A certified arborist visits your property, assesses the job in person, and hands you a clear written quote — with no pressure and no hidden fees.

What This Means in Practice

Our free estimate is a genuine, no-strings-attached service we extend to every property owner in our coverage area. We never charge for a visit, and we never pressure you to book on the spot. According to HomeGuide’s 2026 tree removal pricing guide, removal costs range from $300 to over $2,000 depending on height, access, and site conditions — a spread wide enough that seeing your specific tree in person is the only reliable way to give you an accurate number you can actually plan around.

Why We Built It This Way

Homeowners calling about tree care deserve honest information, not a commitment pressure loop. When we leave your property after an estimate visit, you have a written quote, a clear scope of work, and everything you need to make an informed decision — whether that means booking with us immediately, waiting for the right timing, or getting another opinion first. That is how the process should work.

Section 02  ·  What’s Included

2What’s Included in Our Free Tree Removal Estimate?

A Thorough Assessment, Not a Glance and a Number

Our free estimate is not a quick look from the sidewalk followed by a verbal ballpark. It is a thorough, professional assessment that covers every aspect of your job before we quote a single dollar. Industry standards from ISA-certified arborists hold that a professional estimate should always include a tree health review, a documented scope of work, and direct answers to your technical questions. Here is exactly what you get from every Roubic estimate visit:

  • On-site property visit — An experienced arborist comes to your home and walks the property with you. We look at the actual tree, not a photo of it.
  • Full tree health and risk assessment — We inspect for structural weakness, internal decay, disease, and hazard factors that affect how the job is approached and priced.
  • Complete scope of work — Removal, debris cleanup, log sectioning, and hauling are all discussed and itemized so you know exactly what you are getting.
  • Stump options reviewed on-site — We walk you through whether stump grinding makes sense for your situation, what it involves, and what it adds to the total cost.
  • Clear written quote — You leave the conversation with a written price covering every line item. No vague totals, no scope surprises after the job starts.
  • Zero obligation to book — We never pressure you to schedule on the spot. Your quote is yours to keep and consider at your own pace.

“We scope the job correctly the first time by seeing it in person — that is the only way to give you a number you can actually rely on.”

Section 03  ·  How to Request Yours

3How to Get Your Free Estimate From Roubic Tree Service

The Process From First Contact to Written Quote

Requesting your free estimate takes less than two minutes. Here is the exact process from your first contact through a written quote in hand:

  1. Reach out online or by phone. Visit our contact page and submit the short form, or call us directly. We respond to all requests within one business day.
  2. Tell us about your tree. Share the approximate size, where it is located on your property, and any specific concerns — dead branches, a lean, storm damage, or proximity to your home or power lines.
  3. We schedule your visit. An arborist comes to your property at a time that works for you, including Saturdays for most residential jobs.
  4. We assess, scope, and quote. We spend 20–45 minutes evaluating the tree and your property, then hand you a written quote before we leave.
  5. You decide — on your terms. No follow-up pressure calls. When you are ready to move forward, we are ready to schedule.
Pro Tip

Be present during the estimate if you can. It lets you ask questions on the spot, understand what the job actually involves, and compare our quote fairly against others. HomeGuide recommends getting at least three in-person quotes before committing to any tree removal project — we are always happy to be one of them.

Access, proximity to structures, and site conditions can only be evaluated in person — the four variables that most affect your final quote are invisible in a photo.

Section 04  ·  What Affects Your Quote

4What Factors Influence Your Tree Removal Quote?

Why Every Quote Is Different

Every quote we provide reflects the specific conditions of your property and tree — not a one-size-fits-all price list. This is why tree removal costs in Northeast Ohio can range from $300 to over $3,500 for what might appear to be similar work from the outside. Here are the primary variables our arborist evaluates during your free estimate visit:

Factor Why It Matters Typical Range
Tree height Taller trees require more equipment, rigging, and crew time $150 – $2,000+
Proximity to structures Trees near homes, fences, or power lines require more precise removal methods +$100 – $500
Tree health & stability Diseased or structurally compromised trees carry unpredictable behavior during removal Assessed on-site
Equipment access Tight gates, slopes, or soft ground affect how our equipment can reach the tree Assessed on-site
Stump grinding Optional add-on; stump diameter and root spread determine the cost $75 – $400 per stump
Debris removal Hauling logs and brush away vs. leaving them for firewood or mulch $50 – $200
Number of trees Removing multiple trees in one visit can reduce the cost per tree Discount may apply
Real-World Pricing in Our Area

For a real-world look at what tree removal costs in our service area, read our detailed breakdown of what tree removal actually cost in Pepper Pike, Ohio — including what drove the final number and how the job was scoped from the first estimate visit through site cleanup.

Section 05  ·  Why In-Person Matters

5Why We Insist on In-Person Estimates — Not Online Guesses

In-person inspection is the only way to catch hidden hazards that affect both safety and price.
What Online Quotes Always Miss

You have likely seen websites that offer instant online quotes for tree removal. It sounds convenient — but Angi’s homeowner guide warns that quotes without a site visit routinely miss critical variables and can result in surprise costs once the crew is already on your property. There are four things we simply cannot assess without seeing your property in person:

  • Access. Whether our equipment can reach your tree determines the entire approach. Gates, fencing, utility lines, and soft ground all affect how we work — none of this appears in a photo.
  • Internal decay. A tree that looks healthy from the street can have significant internal rot that changes both the danger level and the removal method. Our arborists are trained to identify these signs on-site.
  • Root proximity. Roots near your foundation, drainage lines, or landscaping features affect stump grinding decisions and what the area will look like after removal.
  • True scope. The difference between a clean open-yard removal and a precision takedown next to a fence line can be $400 or more. We quote what the job actually is — not what it looks like from the curb.
The Professional Standard

The International Society of Arboriculture (ISA) recommends that any professional tree assessment include a thorough visual inspection of the crown, trunk, and root zone before recommending removal. Our estimate visits follow this standard as a baseline, not an extra. For a closer look at how we plan complex, high-risk removals near structures, read our full guide on dangerous tree removal safety standards and what to expect.

Section 06  ·  The Visit Itself

6How Long Does the Free Estimate Visit Take?

20 – 45 Minutes

Most free estimate visits with Roubic Tree & Landscape take between 20 and 45 minutes, depending on the number of trees and the complexity of your property — enough time to evaluate the job thoroughly, never so long it disrupts your day.

What the Arborist Does During Your Visit

Our arborist walks the property with you and inspects each tree you want assessed, identifies structural risk factors — lean, visible decay, branch failure, and proximity hazards — discusses your goals, whether that is full removal, strategic tree trimming, or a health assessment only, walks through stump grinding and cleanup options based on what you plan to do with the space, and answers every question you have before leaving your property. You will not be rushed, and you will not be asked to make a decision on the spot.

Section 07  ·  After the Estimate

7What Happens After You Receive Your Free Quote?

From Written Quote to Finished Yard

Once the estimate visit wraps up, everything moves at your pace. Here is what the process looks like from quote to completed project:

  1. You receive a written quote. Every line item is spelled out — removal, cleanup, stump options, and any special access or safety considerations. No vague totals, no add-ons that were not discussed during the visit.
  2. You take your time. There is no expiration on your quote and no follow-up pressure calls. We are here when you are ready.
  3. You book at your convenience. When you decide to move forward, we schedule the job around you — including Saturday availability for most residential projects.
  4. We handle everything. Our crew arrives on time, performs the work safely, manages all debris, and leaves your yard cleaner than we found it.
See a Real Completed Job From Start to Finish
